purpose: Provenance and licensing register for PlayAtlas runtime/content assets.

asset_policy.runtime_art: Original PlayAtlas vector/2D/3D art only unless a later entry explicitly records a compatible license.
asset_policy.runtime_audio: Original or separately licensed audio only. No downloaded music, sound effects or voice assets are bundled by this register.
asset_policy.rule_text: Tutorial text is rewritten by PlayAtlas. External rule pages are linked as research sources, not copied into the game.
asset_policy.code: No old project code is reused. Third-party code may be added only after license and attribution review.
asset_policy.remote_content: The offline build has no required content server. A future package source must be opt-in and checksum-verified.

runtime_dependencies.name: Godot Engine
runtime_dependencies.notes: Freeze the exact downloaded/editor version in the build manifest. Include the Godot MIT notice in any redistributed build. If the build agent selects a different 4.x patch, update this entry before release.

reference_only_sources.name: Original 2048 project
reference_only_sources.license_observed: MIT in upstream repository; verify current LICENSE before any code reuse
reference_only_sources.use: Mechanic reference only. PlayAtlas implementation and assets are independent.

reference_only_sources.name: Ludii General Game System / Digital Ludeme Project
reference_only_sources.license_observed: Research/database license must be checked per artifact; not assumed reusable
reference_only_sources.use: Rule research entry point for traditional games; no Ludii database, code or images are redistributed in PlayAtlas.

reference_only_sources.name: Wikimedia/Wikipedia pages used as secondary mechanic references
reference_only_sources.license_observed: Per-page Wikimedia terms; not an asset source
reference_only_sources.use: Reading and cross-check only. No article text or images are copied into the build.

planned_asset_sources.name: PlayAtlas original visual system
planned_asset_sources.license: Copyright PlayAtlas project; distribution terms to be chosen by project owner
planned_asset_sources.use: Original board materials, card faces, tile symbols, UI icons, table-sport props and cover images.

planned_asset_sources.name: PlayAtlas original audio system
planned_asset_sources.license: Copyright PlayAtlas project; distribution terms to be chosen by project owner
planned_asset_sources.use: Original short UI/gameplay sounds and optional ambient loops.

planned_asset_sources.name: Operating-system fallback fonts
planned_asset_sources.license: Controlled by the operating system; PlayAtlas does not redistribute them
planned_asset_sources.use: Temporary development fallback only. A release font must be added with an explicit license record before packaging.

release_checks: Run a recursive asset inventory and match every non-source file to a content_source_id.
Do not ship screenshots, logos, card art, music or code copied from referenced games or rule sites.
Check every font, icon and audio file license before Windows/Android export.
Regenerate THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md after any dependency or asset-source change.
Record checksums for release package contents; never claim a remote download source exists until configured and tested.
